Aisha (Product Designer): Heads-up: I prototyped a more compact network step for the Private setup wizard. Idea: show a single-line probe status per check with a subtle action hint rather than huge log dumps. Thoughts?

Tom (Engineer): Leaning towards this. Main risk is that when something fails we need to make debugging obvious. Prefer show one-line status + a clear 'Show full probe output' control that expands the raw text.

Kofi (Accessibility): Accessibility requirements: the expander must be keyboard operable, use aria-expanded, and we should announce status updates via a live region. Also avoid color-only cues on status chips.

Aisha (Product Designer): Proposed layout: status chip (icon + text) on the left, concise hint text on the right (e.g., "Egress to model-hosts.redwood.ai blocked"). Then a chevron labeled 'Show full probe output' that expands to a copyable pre block. Move probe timestamp and raw command into the expanded area.

Marcus (DevEx): Additions: when status = Action required, show a tiny "Try these fixes" box with one-line actionable items and a 'Retry' button inline. KB links should open in a new tab and track click telemetry.

Tom (Engineer): Implementation notes: use a `pre` for logs, add a copy button, cap expansion height to 400px and allow internal scrolling to avoid scroll traps. Also include an optional 'Copy command' button exposing the raw `curl`/`nc` to run locally. Example: `nc -vz model-hosts.redwood.ai 443`

Kofi (Accessibility): Ensure contrast of the chip meets AA. The chevron control should state what's revealed: 'Show full probe output, includes timestamp and raw command'. When probe completes, use aria-live="polite" to notify screen readers.

Marta (PM): SLO/metrics check: still need per-probe timing, status, and whether users expanded details for our UX metrics. Also ensure the Retry action surfaces to backend telemetry.

Aisha (Product Designer): I'll update the Figma: compact row, chip + hint + chevron, expanded pre with copy & raw command + KB link + Retry. Will add microcopy for the Try fixes suggestions.

Tom (Engineer): One more thought: for recurring infra flakiness, could auto-suggest 'Use a different routing region' or a soft fallback to a lower-sensitivity probe. But that's follow-up.
